channel.title: EOLkits — AWS Deprecation Radar
channel.description: Tracked AWS deprecation milestones for Lambda runtimes and Amazon Linux 2, with provider source links and bounded migration checks to validate.

item.title: Amazon Linux 2 EOL — milestone 2026-06-30
item.description: Deadline 2026-06-30 (critical). Amazon Linux 2 reached end of life on 2026-06-30 and should be migrated to Amazon Linux 2023. AWS has published post-EOL AL2 releases, so EOLkits does not equate the date with proof that a specific instance has received no later update; verify the installed release and current AWS support terms. Migration checks to validate: Standard support ended; remaining update/support behavior must be verified with AWS; yum replaced with dnf; amazon-linux-extras not available; ntpd replaced with chronyd; iptables replaced with nftables; Python 2 no longer available. Provider status source: https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/update-on-amazon-linux-2-end-of-life/

item.title: Lambda Node.js 20 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-07-29
item.description: Deadline 2027-07-29 (high). Node.js 20 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2023) was deprecated on 2026-04-30 (no further security patches). Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new nodejs20.x functions on 2027-07-29 and updating existing ones on 2027-08-31. Migration checks to validate: CreateFunction and UpdateFunctionConfiguration API calls fail after the published block dates; aws-sdk v2 not bundled (use @aws-sdk/* v3 modular clients); Node.js 22/24 removes crypto.createCipher and deprecates built-in punycode; Native N-API addons must be verified against Node.js 22/24 ABI. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Node.js 22 projected create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-07-29
item.description: Deadline 2027-07-29 (medium). Node.js 22 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2023) has a projected deprecation date of 2027-05-30. AWS currently projects blocking new nodejs22.x functions on 2027-07-29 and updates on 2027-08-31; AWS marks runtime dates as subject to change. Migration checks to validate: Upgrade target is nodejs24.x on Amazon Linux 2023; Native addons must be rebuilt and tested on the Node.js 24 ABI. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Python 3.9 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-07-29
item.description: Deadline 2027-07-29 (high). Python 3.9 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2) was deprecated on 2025-12-15 (no further security patches). Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new python3.9 functions on 2027-07-29 and blocks updating existing ones on 2027-08-31. Functions keep running, but remain unpatched and become unmodifiable after the block dates. Migration checks to validate: distutils module removed in Python 3.12 (PEP 632); imp module removed in Python 3.12; collections.Mapping and legacy ABC aliases removed; Base OS moves from Amazon Linux 2 (glibc 2.26) to AL2023 (glibc 2.34). Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Python 3.10 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-07-29
item.description: Deadline 2027-07-29 (high). Python 3.10 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2) was deprecated by AWS on 2026-10-31 (no further security patches). Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new python3.10 functions on 2027-07-29 and blocks updating existing ones on 2027-08-31. Migration checks to validate: distutils, imp, asyncore, asynchat, and smtpd removed in Python 3.12; PEP 594 removes cgi, telnetlib, crypt, audioop, pipes, aifc, and lib2to3 in Python 3.13; datetime.utcnow() deprecated in Python 3.12; Native C/Rust wheels must be built for AL2023 (glibc 2.34) and matching CPU architecture. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda .NET 8 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-07-29
item.description: Deadline 2027-07-29 (high). .NET 8 Lambda runtime (dotnet8 on Amazon Linux 2023) was deprecated on 2026-11-10 following upstream .NET 8 end of support. Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new dotnet8 functions on 2027-07-29 and updating existing ones on 2027-08-31. Migration checks to validate: Upgrade target is dotnet10 (<TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>); Update Amazon.Lambda.* NuGet packages and aws-lambda-tools-defaults.json runtime field; Recompile native AOT or architecture-specific dependencies for AL2023. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda provided.al2 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-07-29
item.description: Deadline 2027-07-29 (high). The Amazon Linux 2 OS-only custom runtime (provided.al2) was deprecated on 2026-07-31. Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new provided.al2 functions on 2027-07-29 and updating existing ones on 2027-08-31. Migration checks to validate: Upgrade target is provided.al2023 (Amazon Linux 2023 minimal base image); AL2023 ships a minimal container footprint without tzdata or extra system libraries unless layered in; Recompile Go, Rust, or C++ custom bootstrap binaries against glibc 2.34 or static musl. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Python 3.11 projected create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-07-29
item.description: Deadline 2027-07-29 (medium). AWS currently projects Python 3.11 Lambda runtime deprecation on 2027-06-30, blocking new python3.11 functions on 2027-07-29, and blocking updates on 2027-08-31. AWS marks future runtime dates as subject to change. Migration checks to validate: distutils is removed in Python 3.12; Python 3.11 is the last Amazon Linux 2 Python runtime; upgrading moves to AL2023 (glibc 2.34); Native dependencies may need Python 3.12/3.13-compatible wheels. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Node.js 16 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-07-29
item.description: Deadline 2027-07-29 (high). Node.js 16 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2) deprecated 2024-06-12. Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new nodejs16.x functions on 2027-07-29 and updating existing ones on 2027-08-31. Migration checks to validate: Upgrade target is nodejs24.x; validate application and dependency compatibility before changing the function runtime; aws-sdk v2 preinstalled on nodejs16.x; nodejs18.x+ bundles AWS SDK for JavaScript v3 instead (require('aws-sdk') stops resolving); Native addons must be rebuilt and tested on the Node.js 24 ABI and AL2023; OpenSSL 3 behavior changes. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Node.js 18 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-07-29
item.description: Deadline 2027-07-29 (high). Node.js 18 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2) deprecated 2025-09-01. Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new nodejs18.x functions on 2027-07-29 and updating existing ones on 2027-08-31. Migration checks to validate: Upgrade target is nodejs24.x; aws-sdk v2 not bundled (use @aws-sdk v3 modular clients); Native addons must be rebuilt and tested on the Node.js 24 ABI and AL2023; OpenSSL 3 and Node 22+ crypto.createCipher removal. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html

item.title: Lambda Python 3.8 create/update restrictions — milestone 2027-07-29
item.description: Deadline 2027-07-29 (high). Python 3.8 Lambda runtime (Amazon Linux 2) deprecated 2024-10-14. Per the AWS Lambda runtime deprecation table, AWS blocks creating new python3.8 functions on 2027-07-29 and updating existing ones on 2027-08-31. Migration checks to validate: Upgrade target is python3.12 (3.13 available); distutils and imp removed in 3.12 (fix on upgrade); collections ABCs moved to collections.abc (3.10+); Native wheels may need version bumps for cp312 on AL2023. Provider status source: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/lambda/latest/dg/lambda-runtimes.html
